sentences.text: وَدَخَلَ يُوسُفُ السِّجْنَ، وَعَرَفَ أَهْلُ السِّجْنِ جَمِيعًا أَنَّ يُوسُفَ شَابٌّ كَرِيمٌ.
sentences.translation: And Yusuf entered prison, and all the inmates of prison knew that Yusuf was a noble young man.

sentences.text: وَأَنَّ يُوسُفَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ، وَأَنَّ يُوسُفَ فِي صَدْرِهِ قَلْبٌ رَحِيمٌ.
sentences.translation: And that Yusuf possessed great knowledge, and that Yusuf had a merciful heart in his chest.
And the people of the prison loved Yusuf and honored him.
And the people rejoiced in Yusuf and held him in high regard.

sentences.text: وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجْنَ رَجُلَانِ وَقَصَّا عَلَيْهِ رُؤْيَاهُمَا.
sentences.translation: And two men entered the prison with him and related to him their dreams.

sentences.text: وَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا إِنِّي أَرَانِي أَعْصِرُ خَمْرًا وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ إِنِّي أَرَانِي أَحْمِلُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِي خُبْزًا تَأْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ مِنْهُ.
sentences.translation: And one of them said: 'Indeed I saw myself pressing wine.' And the other said: 'Indeed I saw myself carrying bread upon my head, from which the birds eat.'

sentences.text: وَسَأَلَا يُوسُفَ عَنِ التَّأْوِيلِ، وَكَانَ يُوسُفُ عَالِمًا بِتَأْوِيلِ الرُّؤْيَا.
sentences.translation: And they asked Yusuf about the interpretation, and Yusuf was knowledgeable in the interpretation of dreams.
And Yusuf was a prophet among the prophets.

sentences.text: وَكَانَ النَّاسُ فِي زَمَانِهِ يَعْبُدُونَ غَيْرَ اللهِ، وَوَضَعُوا أَرْبَابًا كَثِيرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِهِمْ.
sentences.translation: And the people in his time worshipped other than Allah, and set up many deities from their own minds.

sentences.text: وَقَالُوا هٰذَا رَبُّ الْبَرِّ، وَهٰذَا رَبُّ الْبَحْرِ، وَهٰذَا رَبُّ الرِّزْقِ، وَهٰذَا رَبُّ الْمَطَرِ.
sentences.translation: And they said: This is the lord of land, and this is the lord of the sea, and this is the lord of sustenance, and this is the lord of rain.

sentences.text: وَكَانَ يُوسُفُ يَرَى كُلَّ ذٰلِكَ وَيَضْحَكُ، وَكَانَ يُوسُفُ يَعْلَمُ كُلَّ ذٰلِكَ وَيَبْكِي، وَكَانَ يُوسُفُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَهُمْ إِلَى اللهِ.
sentences.translation: And Yusuf used to see all of that and laugh, and Yusuf used to know all of that and weep, and Yusuf wanted to call them to Allah.

sentences.text: وَقَدْ أَرَادَ اللهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ ذٰلِكَ فِي السِّجْنِ.
sentences.translation: And Allah willed that that should occur in prison.

sentences.text: أَلَا يَسْتَحِقُّ أَهْلُ السِّجْنِ الْمَوْعِظَةَ؟ أَلَا يَسْتَحِقُّ أَهْلُ السِّجْنِ الرَّحْمَةَ؟
sentences.translation: Do not the inmates of prison deserve the exhortation? Do not the inmates of prison deserve mercy?

sentences.text: أَلَيْسَ أَهْلُ السِّجْنِ عِبَادَ اللهِ؟ أَلَيْسَ أَهْلُ السِّجْنِ بَنِي آدَمَ؟
sentences.translation: Are not the inmates of prison the servants of Allah? Are not the inmates of prison children of Adam?

breakdown.taqdeer: مَجْرُورٌ بِالْفَتْحَةِ لِأَنَّهُ مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ

sentences.text: كَانَ يُوسُفُ فِي السِّجْنِ وَلٰكِنَّهُ كَانَ حُرًّا جَرِيئًا.
sentences.translation: Yusuf was in prison, but he was free and bold.

sentences.text: كَانَ يُوسُفُ فَقِيرًا وَلٰكِنَّهُ كَانَ جَوَادًا سَخِيًّا.
sentences.translation: Yusuf was poor, but he was generous and bountiful.

sentences.text: إِنَّ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ يَجْهَرُونَ بِالْحَقِّ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، إِنَّ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ يَجُودُونَ بِالْخَيْرِ فِي كُلِّ زَمَانٍ.
sentences.translation: Indeed the prophets proclaim the truth everywhere; indeed the prophets bestow good at all times.
